The absolute-trend gate validates eligibility for 38 of 49 themes, indicating broad trend health, yet the leader's grip is weakening. Given the poor historical track record (hit rate 40%, directional accuracy 25%), all convictions remain low.
emerging_watch: Watch for a confirmed leadership handoff from Memory, HBM & Storage to AI Infrastructure.
